title: ClickHouse Cluster Health — Overview
subtitle: A health snapshot from the anonymized system tables. Memory tables (parts, metrics, disks, replicas) are a point-in-time snapshot taken when the sandbox was built; *_log tables cover the trailing window. Identifiers shown in this report are de-anonymized for the reader.

panels.text:
## What this report covers
This is the fast health routing view, modeled on the Altinity *clickhouse-overview* expert skill. It rolls up object counts, resource pressure, disk headroom and replication into one screen, then flags anything outside the recommended envelope. Drill into the linked reports for **query workload**, **parts & merges**, and **logs & errors**.

- **Object counts** — table/part sprawl that inflates metadata and slows restarts.
- **Resource pressure** — memory resident vs. OS total.
- **Disks** — local-disk headroom.
- Anything not `OK` is narrated under **Attention** below.

panels.query: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM system_anon.tables WHERE engine LIKE '%MergeTree%') AS mt_tables, (SELECT count() FROM system_anon.parts WHERE active) AS active_parts, (SELECT countDistinct(normalized_query_hash) FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE event_time > now() - 86400) AS query_shapes, (SELECT toFloat64(value) FROM system_anon.asynchronous_metrics WHERE metric = 'MemoryResident') AS mem_resident, (SELECT toFloat64(value) FROM system_anon.asynchronous_metrics WHERE metric = 'OSMemoryTotal') AS mem_total

panels.title: Object counts audit
panels.query: SELECT c.1 AS check_name, c.2 AS value, multiIf(c.2 > c.3, 'Critical', c.2 > c.4, 'Major', c.2 > c.5, 'Moderate', 'OK') AS severity FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([('MergeTree tables', toUInt64((SELECT count() FROM system_anon.tables WHERE engine LIKE '%MergeTree%')), 10000, 3000, 1000), ('Distinct databases', toUInt64((SELECT uniqExact(database) FROM system_anon.tables)), 1000, 300, 100), ('Active parts', toUInt64((SELECT count() FROM system_anon.parts WHERE active)), 120000, 90000, 60000), ('Current queries', toUInt64((SELECT count() FROM system_anon.processes WHERE is_cancelled = 0)), 100, 50, 50)]) AS c) ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Disk headroom
panels.query: SELECT name AS disk, formatReadableSize(total_space) AS total, formatReadableSize(free_space) AS free, round(100.0 * (total_space - free_space) / total_space, 1) AS used_pct FROM system_anon.disks WHERE total_space > 0 ORDER BY used_pct DESC

panels.title: Memory pressure
panels.template: Server is holding **{{mem_resident|bytes!}}** resident out of {{mem_total|bytes}} OS memory — roughly {{mem_resident|bytes}} of working set. Primary-key indexes and dictionaries live inside that footprint; watch it against the *clickhouse-memory* skill thresholds before scaling reads.

panels.query: SELECT check_name, value, severity FROM (SELECT c.1 AS check_name, c.2 AS value, multiIf(c.2 > c.3, 'Critical', c.2 > c.4, 'Major', c.2 > c.5, 'Moderate', 'OK') AS severity FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([('MergeTree tables', toUInt64((SELECT count() FROM system_anon.tables WHERE engine LIKE '%MergeTree%')), 10000, 3000, 1000), ('Active parts', toUInt64((SELECT count() FROM system_anon.parts WHERE active)), 120000, 90000, 60000), ('Current queries', toUInt64((SELECT count() FROM system_anon.processes WHERE is_cancelled = 0)), 100, 50, 50)]) AS c)) WHERE severity != 'OK' ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Attention
panels.template: **{{check_name}}** is at {{value|num}} — flagged **{{severity!}}**. Compare against the recommended envelope and route to the matching expert skill.

panels.text: *If **Attention** is empty, every rolled-up check is within its recommended envelope.* This view intentionally favors narrative over charts — it is a router, not a time-series console. Follow the workload, parts, and logs reports for trends.
